description: Vampire Survivors + 3 DLC (Emergency Meeting v1.11.108, native Linux Unity / IL2CPP, Goldberg Steam shim)
long: Vampire Survivors is a minimalist roguelike action game where the player survives waves of monsters with auto-firing weapons, collecting gems to level up and combine items into powerful evolutions. Runs last a limited time as the screen fills with enemies and bullet-hell-like carnage. It was developed by poncle and supports local couch co-op.
